challenge.method: Test a GPL-2.0-only interpretation against the sentence referring to a verbatim GPLv2 copy in COPYING and the definition inside the exception itself.
challenge.results: The copy in COPYING identifies a reproduced edition. Both the project's opening notice and the controlling inline definition explicitly allow later GPL versions. The definition also requires a based work to be GPL-licensed.

limitations: Both conditions on a based work matter. The source describes a distribution carrying the permission and leaves particular combinations and later OpenSSL license regimes outside this finding.
The named variant is explicit in the document. The opaque registry target's own record is outside the named dependencies.
